text:
Alex Kim: SummitMart wants a 3-week POC: streaming product classifier (target <250ms), nightly bulk embeddings, and a price tool-call. Also asked for a ballpark for ~10M tokens/month and SOC2/KMS details.

Priya Rao: Hosted is fine for the POC but they may prefer Dedicated if latency checks out. Can we offer a time-limited Dedicated pool? @Nate (Eng)

Nate (Eng): We can provision a small Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) for the trial. Need 48h lead time, signed trial terms, and the customer's IP ranges. Customer-managed KMS supported; we'll require key ARN for setup.

Leo Zhang: For integration, here's a tiny streaming SDK example they can run. Final output will be a deterministic JSON schema (sku, category, confidence, tags[], price.value/currency/source).

Leo Zhang: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
with client.stream('classify', model='redwood-gen-3') as s:
    s.send({"text": "Item: \"Wild Blueberry Jam\"", "schema": "catalog_item_v1", "tool_calls": ["price_lookup"]})
    for chunk in s.iter_chunks():
        print(chunk.text)
```

Leo Zhang: Example final payload:

```json
{
  "sku": "JAM-WBL-001",
  "category": "grocery/jams",
  "confidence": 0.96,
  "tags": ["artisan","local"],
  "price": {"value": 6.49, "currency": "USD", "source": "price_lookup_v1"}
}
```

Samira Patel: Ballpark pricing for ~10M mixed gen+embeddings on hosted is about ~$2k/month (depends on model mix). I'll get a formal quote from finance; Dedicated trial pricing is separate.

Alex Kim: Security asked if PII is retained and about logs retention. Can we add canned answers?

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II report available under NDA. Default logs retention 30 days (contract-adjustable). Customer-managed KMS supported; data unreadable without key. PII redaction hooks and configurable caching/retention policies available.

Alex Kim: SummitMart requested an end-to-end demo (streaming -> tool-call -> S3 sink) next Wed. Nate will draft runbook + terraform snippet for short-lived creds and IP allowlist. Samira will send the preliminary pricing by tomorrow. Keeping this thread for coordination. :white_check_mark:
